name: Rochester Day Camp (Camp Coney Pine)
activities: specialty camps (fort building, Lego, ultimate sports, DIY art)
description_short: YMCA day camp at Camp Coney Pine in Rochester, run by the Somersworth branch of The Granite YMCA, for kids entering grades 1 to 8 in groups by grade, with swimming, archery, arts, STEM and theme weeks. Older campers take field trips, and there are specialty weeks plus LIT and CIT programs for teens up to grade 11.
refund_policy_summary: Each week needs a $35 nonrefundable deposit. Cancel more than 6 weeks before the camp week for a full refund less the deposit; 3 to 6 weeks before, a $65 admin fee is also kept; less than 3 weeks before, no refund.

sessions.name: Camp Remix Week 10: Blast from the Past

notes: Camp runs 8:30 am to 4 pm, with before care from 7 am and after care to 5:30 pm at no extra charge. Weekly prices are in the Y's day camp brochure, which is a flipbook and was not read.
